article_title: Inside the Secret Service 'shell game' to hide US presidents in plain sight

tasks.prompt: What is the central idea of the article?
options: Presidential travel relies only on stronger armour
The Secret Service uses layered deception and decoys to make a president's true location uncertain
US presidents no longer travel by air
Journalists plan presidential security operations
tasks.correct_answer: The Secret Service uses layered deception and decoys to make a president's true location uncertain
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה כיצד השירות החשאי משלב כלי רכב זהים, מסלולים חלופיים ותחבולות מורכבות כדי להסתיר את מיקום הנשיא.

tasks.prompt: What happened during the extraordinary departure from the NATO summit in Ankara?
options: The president travelled home openly by train
The president left Air Force One in a catering truck and boarded a different military aircraft
Every passenger was moved to the presidential limousine
The summit was relocated to Washington without notice
tasks.correct_answer: The president left Air Force One in a catering truck and boarded a different military aircraft
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הנשיא הוצא בחשאי מאייר פורס וואן באמצעות משאית קייטרינג והועבר למטוס צבאי אחר.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what are “unwitting decoys”?
options: People who knowingly volunteer to attract danger
People used as a distraction without realizing it
Armoured cars that cannot move
Agents who reveal the travel plan
tasks.correct_answer: People used as a distraction without realizing it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: unwitting decoys הם אנשים ששימשו להסחת דעת בלי שידעו על תפקידם בתוכנית.

tasks.prompt: How does the motorcade's “shell game” make the president harder to target?
options: It repeatedly changes which identical-looking vehicle appears to carry the president
It removes all security vehicles from the route
It publishes the president's exact seat location
It keeps the limousine parked at the airport
tasks.correct_answer: It repeatedly changes which identical-looking vehicle appears to carry the president
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בשיירה נעים כלי רכב דומים ומשנים מיקום, כך שצופה עוין מתקשה לדעת באיזה מהם נמצא הנשיא.

tasks.prompt: Why can uncertainty itself improve presidential security?
options: It makes the motorcade travel more slowly
It forces an adversary to guess, hesitate or divide attention among possible targets
It guarantees that intelligence reports are unnecessary
It allows every journey to use the same route
tasks.correct_answer: It forces an adversary to guess, hesitate or divide attention among possible targets
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר היריב אינו יודע מהו היעד האמיתי, עליו לנחש או להסס, והסיכוי לתקיפה מדויקת קטן.

tasks.prompt: What is a “contingency” in the context of Secret Service planning?
options: A public timetable for reporters
A possible emergency situation for which a backup plan is prepared
An ordinary limousine maintenance check
A legal order to cancel all travel
tasks.correct_answer: A possible emergency situation for which a backup plan is prepared
tasks.explanation_hebrew: contingency הוא תרחיש אפשרי, לרוב מצב חירום, שעבורו מכינים מראש תוכנית חלופית.

tasks.prompt: Describe two different deception methods discussed in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר שתי שיטות שונות ולהסביר בקצרה כיצד כל אחת מסתירה את מיקום הנשיא.
expected_points: Identical-looking limousines weave within the motorcade as moving decoys
A visible presidential aircraft can remain in place while the president transfers secretly
A catering truck concealed the president's movement between aircraft
Staff and journalists aboard the original plane served as unwitting decoys

tasks.prompt: Summarise how routine and extraordinary deception measures work together to protect a US president.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להשוות בין ההטעיה היומיומית בשיירה לבין מבצע חריג המבוסס על מודיעין ואיום ממשי.
expected_points: Routine motorcades use duplicate vehicles and movement to obscure the president's location
Agents prepare contingency plans for several threat scenarios
More elaborate measures may be used abroad when intelligence indicates a substantial threat
The Ankara aircraft switch illustrates a large-scale deception operation

tasks.prompt: Why must agents both prepare detailed plans and remain ready to improvise?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שתכנון מכסה תרחישים צפויים, אך מידע חדש או שינוי בשטח מחייב התאמה מהירה בלי לחשוף את הנשיא.
expected_points: Contingency planning provides rehearsed responses to known risks
Threat intelligence can change shortly before or during travel
Real locations and timing may not match the prepared scenario
Improvisation allows agents to preserve secrecy and move the president safely

tasks.prompt: The article notes that some people may become decoys without knowing it. Discuss the security benefit and the ethical concern raised by that tactic.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את התועלת המבצעית, את הסיכון או שאלת ההסכמה, ולהגיע למסקנה מאוזנת המבוססת על פרטי הכתבה.
expected_points: Unwitting behaviour can make the deception more convincing
Keeping the plan secret can protect the president during a serious threat
People used as decoys may face risk without informed consent
The reported lack of a legal obligation does not remove the ethical question
A balanced judgment about necessity and responsibility
